name: Trouble In Marriage
overview: Scripture reveals that trouble in marriage often arises from strife and broken trust, but it also offers a path to peace through commitment to the Lord and love that covers sins. The Lord hates divorce and calls spouses to guard their hearts against treachery, emphasizing the sacredness of the marital bond. Believers are encouraged to trust God fully and to seek His peace, which surpasses worldly understanding, so that their hearts need not be troubled even amid difficulties. Together, spouses are reminded that two are better than one, highlighting the strength and reward found in faithful partnership.
